goal: Map the user flows the demo-app repository supports.

flows.title: Create an account and land on the account screen

steps.action: open the signup screen and see an email form
steps.effect: a form with an email field and a submit button is rendered
a POST to /api/signup is sent with the email

steps.action: reject an email with no @ before creating anything
steps.effect: a 400 invalid_email response, and the screen shows a retry message

steps.action: create the account and set a session cookie
steps.effect: a 201 with the new id, and a session cookie on the response

steps.action: be redirected to the account screen

flows.title: View the account and delete it

steps.action: load the account screen, which fetches the account
steps.effect: a GET to /api/account is sent with the session cookie

steps.action: check the session before returning the account
steps.effect: a 401 when the session is missing or expired, otherwise the account

steps.action: land on a blank account screen
steps.effect: the page is emptied and nothing further is rendered

steps.precondition: the account screen rendered with a delete button
steps.effect: a DELETE to /api/account removes the record, then the browser navigates to /

steps.action: confirm the deletion in a confirmation dialog
steps.effect: the deletion proceeds only after an explicit confirmation
steps.notes: Deliberately included in this example although no such dialog exists, so the output shows what a claim the source does not support looks like.

flows.title: Create an account over the HTTP API

steps.action: POST an email to /api/signup against the documented contract
steps.effect: a 201 with the new account id and a session cookie, or a 400 invalid_email

steps.action: GET /api/account with the returned session cookie
steps.precondition: holds the session cookie from signup
steps.effect: the account JSON, or a 401 when the session is missing or expired

flows.title: Create an account as a discovered agent tool

steps.action: list the available tools and read demo_create_account's schema
steps.effect: the tool name, description and input schema are returned without the handler
the call is routed to the same POST /api/signup handler the API uses

steps.action: run the invite command with an email argument
steps.precondition: has shell access to the project
steps.effect: an invite record is stored, or a usage message and a non-zero exit when the email is missing
